title: StalkShift 1.0
closeGame: Close ETS2 completely and run this again.
closeBridge: Close the running StalkShift window first.
badGame: This folder does not contain the Windows x64 ETS2 executable.
badPackage: Package is incomplete or its files do not match. Extract the entire release ZIP again.
profiles: Optional: remove duplicate MOZA stalk button bindings from one profile. Keyboard, wheel and pedal bindings stay in place.
noBindings: No direct MOZA stalk button bindings found in this profile.
installed: Installed. Connect MOZA by USB, select Multi function key switch direct in Pit House, then open Start.cmd and launch ETS2.
installFirst: Run Install.cmd from this release before starting the bridge.
noDevice: MOZA stalks were not found. Check USB and Pit House. A wheel base alone is not the stalk device.
device: Choose MOZA interface number shown in square brackets
running: Keep this window open while playing. Ctrl+C stops the bridge. The game is ready when ready=true appears. Move controls again after loading or pausing.
removed: StalkShift plugin removed. Other game plugins were not changed.
profileChanged: Profile was edited since installation. It was left as-is; the original is in the backup folder.
pluginChanged: Installed DLL differs from this installation record. Run Install.cmd for the current release before uninstalling.
access: If access was denied in the ETS2 folder, run Install.cmd or Uninstall.cmd as administrator. Start.cmd does not need administrator rights.
